OSTEOMYELITIS WITH STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS

Treat for 4 weeks

# ________________________________________________

# Methicillin-SUSCEPTIBLE S. aureus

# ________________________________________________

# Treatment

[Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID \($\) R,DI < OR >](psozid2-tmp-sulfa-28days-1ds-tab-bid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-tmp-sulfa-28days-1ds-tab-bid)

< OR >

[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO BID \($\) R](psozid2-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-bid-28ds)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-bid-28days)
